newsitem.title: CANADA: Arimetco U.S unit files for reorganization.
newsitem.headline: Arimetco U.S unit files for reorganization.

text.p: Arimetco International Inc said on Friday its wholly held unit, Arimetco Inc, filed for reorganization under Chapter 11 of the United States Federal Bankruptcy Code in a court in Tuscon, Arizona.

"For the past six months, the company has experienced serious production problems at its Yerington Mine caused by a component of its MacArthur ore which tends to cause build-up in its solvent extraction plant. This resulted in lower production and higher operating costs," Arimetco said.
The filing will give Arimetco Inc enough time to solve its production problems and to reorganize its financial affairs.
The company will continue to operate its businesses as debtor in possession.
"Management is optimistic that Arimetco Inc will successfully reorganize and emerge as a stronger and more viable entity," Arimetco International said.

Arimetco International said Arimetco Inc now appears to have developed a solution to the problem. But the combined impact of lower production, higher ongoing operating costs related to the problems, holding costs on non-producing properties and equipment lease costs caused a financial crisis.
Shares in Arimetco Inc plunged to a low of 0.22. At midday, they were trading down a hefty 0.395, or 62.7 percent, at 0.235 in volume of 673,300 shares.
